description: Test suite for the Legend React component, verifying rendering, accessibility, interaction, and styling behavior.

methods.name: test("renders Symbols header, reset button, items, and note text")
methods.description: Verifies that the Legend component renders headers, buttons, toggle switches, and descriptive texts correctly.

methods.name: test("applies aria-checked and visual marker opacity/label data-active based on visibleSet")
methods.description: Checks that accessibility attributes and visual indicators are correctly updated based on the visible set of series.

methods.name: test("marker shape class is square for point-square else circle")
methods.description: Ensures the shape class applied to markers corresponds to the item type ('square' or 'circle').

methods.name: test("clicking an item calls onToggle with the series id; clicking reset calls onReset")
methods.description: Verifies that user interactions trigger the appropriate callback functions with correct arguments.

methods.name: test("hover/focus triggers onHover and mouseleave/blur triggers onHoverEnd; optional chaining is safe when handlers missing")
methods.description: Tests hover and focus interactions, including the safety of optional callback handlers, and ensures callback invocation.
